goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: ETHUSDT EMA Trend Gate - Cross-Asset Generalization Test
plan.objective: Test whether EMA Trend Gate strategy (proven on BTC) generalizes to ETHUSDT with multi-year deep history
plan.hypothesis: The 4h EMA trend gate filtering 1h RSI mean-reversion signals, which achieved 0.998 OOS Sharpe on BTC, will produce similarly robust results on ETHUSDT - testing cross-asset generalization within crypto
plan.strategy_rationale: EMA_TREND_GATE is the highest-performing strategy from recent runs (BTC 0.998 OOS Sharpe, -6.9% DD, 848 trades). Testing on ETH validates whether the multi-timeframe regime filter approach generalizes across liquid crypto assets. This directly follows from the lesson that BTC outperformed ETH in the prior run - now testing if ETH can match BTC performance with optimized parameters.
dataset_requirements: OHLCV 1h bars for ETHUSDT from Binance with maximum available history

historical_depth_requirement.justification: ETHUSDT has the deepest available history among liquid crypto datasets (64k bars vs BTC 43k). Multi-year history required for robust WFA across multiple market cycles. This exceeds minimum for statistical validity.

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing deep dataset in workspace/data/binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv already contains ~64k bars of clean 1h OHLCV data - no download needed. This is the deepest crypto dataset available in the factory.

plan.scope_selection_rationale: ETHUSDT selected as the liquid crypto instrument with deepest available history (~7.5 years). This maximizes WFA window count and ensures testing across multiple market cycles (bull, bear, sideways). Prior BTC run achieved 57 windows; ETH should achieve similar or more windows given longer history.

data_acquisition.reason: Existing deep dataset binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv contains 64734 rows (~7.5 years of 1h data) - sufficient for full WFA without additional download

inputs: factory/memory/lessons.jsonl (for prior EMA_TREND_GATE results on BTC)
implementation_steps: 1. Verify ETHUSDT deep data exists and has correct columns (timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume)
2. Create WFA config for EMA_TREND_GATE on ETHUSDT 1h (or update existing config to point to ETHUSDT)
3. Execute WFA using canonical path: walk forward engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py
4. Capture execution artifacts: execution-result.json, evaluation.json, summary.json
5. Compare OOS Sharpe to BTC baseline (0.998) and ETH prior result (0.528)

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA must complete with at least 30 OOS trades and valid metrics

fallback_if_blocked: If ETHUSDT data has issues, fall back to BNBUSDT (43k bars, ~5 years)
If WFA fails on ETH, document as blocked with specific error
notes: This is a cross-asset generalization test - we already have BTC results, now testing ETH to see if strategy generalizes
Prior BTC run achieved 0.998 OOS Sharpe with -6.9% max DD over 57 windows and 848 trades
ETH has longer history so should achieve similar or more WFA windows
Compare results to both BTC (0.998) and prior ETH run (0.528) to measure improvement
